paper_metadata.title: Prognostic significance of abnormal hematological parameters in severe traumatic brain injury requiring decompressive craniectomy

quips_assessment.risk_reasoning: The study uses a comprehensive statewide database covering all adult neurotrauma centers in the region, ensuring the sample is highly representative of the target population (severe TBI requiring surgery). Inclusion/exclusion and baseline characteristics are well-defined.

items.reasoning: The authors clearly define the geographical and institutional source of the population.
